requirements.text: Create ARCHITECTURE.md at the repository root answering the six questions from the captured practice for THIS system: (1) what exists - the high-level map (Next.js frontend, FastAPI services, connectors, deterministic rules engine, spatial substrate, Supabase, Render, the project-control plane, the agent supervisor); (2) who owns what; (3) what may depend on what, including explicitly documented FORBIDDEN paths; (4) how data moves - the critical flows with provenance; (5) what must stay true - the architectural invariants (AI never calculates, deterministic code never guesses sources, secrets server-side, fail-safe never fabricates, orchestrator-only git/ledger); (6) when an agent must STOP (boundary-breaking tasks: stop, explain conflict, show impact, propose smallest change). Not a file tour; only what is hard to infer safely; consistent with CLAUDE.md and the path-scoped rules without duplicating them.
requirements.required_harness: Independent review (G3) verifies every statement against the actual code/ledger; no invented components.
requirements.required_evidence: ARCHITECTURE.md at repo root, gated and accepted.

requirements.text: Create the repo-local review skill .claude/skills/pr-review/SKILL.md invocable as /pr-review [branch|<target>]: reviews a diff for the four captured dimensions tuned to THIS repository - code quality (complexity, duplication, abstractions, modularity policy), test adequacy (do tests cover the changed behavior; recording-spy/negative/mutation standards), security (trust boundaries, unsafe inputs, secret/provenance leaks, dependency policy), backward/contract compatibility (API contracts, schemas, provenance chains, accepted-task immutability) - plus the repo-specific dimensions: provenance discipline and fail-safe correctness. Output discipline verbatim from the captured practice: only actionable problems, each pointing to the relevant code with the failure scenario; anything unverifiable explicitly marked UNPROVEN.
requirements.required_harness: Skill text review + a trial invocation on a real recent diff.
requirements.required_evidence: .claude/skills/pr-review/SKILL.md, gated and accepted; trial-run transcript in the producer report.

requirements.text: Fold the evidence-before-DONE vocabulary (REQUIREMENT / TEST / REGRESSION / DIFF / UNPROVEN) into the two new artifacts BY CITATION of the existing stronger law (gates, producer-cannot-self-accept, independent verification, UNVERIFIABLE status, /engineering-reliability) - never as a duplicate second checklist that could drift from the ledger rules.
requirements.required_evidence: The artifacts cite the existing mechanisms; no new parallel completion protocol introduced.

requirements.text: PROHIBITION: nothing in this directive weakens or bypasses any existing gate, hold, or policy; the new skill is advisory review tooling and never substitutes for /run-quality-gate or any ledger gate; no supervisor code is in scope.
requirements.required_evidence: Session and ledger records show no gate/hold change.
